title: Chapter 50 — The Warm Path: Mining Your Existing Book
intro: The fastest accounts come from relationships you already have.

sections.title: Start With Who You Know
sections.content:
Before cold calling, mine your existing relationships. Past retail customers who are builders. Contractors who bought for their own home. Designers who shopped your store personally.

The bridge call is simple: 'I know you do renovation work. Have you thought about where you source appliances for your projects? I would love to earn that business.'

Warm leads convert faster than cold ones. Always.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating warm-path mining, ask:

Has the salesperson reviewed their existing customer base for trade opportunities?
Are they making bridge calls — or only waiting for trade customers to find them?
